comment: v2.4 patches (after settings-v2.3.json): bottom safe-area goes full-bleed — adaptive on every device (the shell WebView is edge-to-edge; any residual bottom inset would otherwise leave a dark band under the HUD).

patches.replace: --sa-b: 0px; /* shell: full-bleed bottom (adaptive edge-to-edge; no reserved band on any device) */

.set-apply:disabled { opacity: .4; }
.set-seg__note { display: block; font-size: .09rem; opacity: .55; margin-top: .02rem; font-style: normal; }
